Simulate a path from a model

Source: R/aci-model.R
aci_simulate.Rd

The named verb for the package's simulate.stochastic_model() method. It exists so that the public surface reads as one family of aci_* verbs. It is the same call, with the same arguments and the same draws, and the S3 method stays registered on the stats::simulate() generic, so simulate(model) keeps working.

Usage

aci_simulate(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A stochastic_model or cgns_model object.

...

Passed to the simulate() method: nsim, seed, t_end, dt, ic, burn_in, keep_hidden, keep_noise.

Value

Whatever the method returns: an aci_sim object, or a list of them when nsim exceeds one.

See also

simulate.stochastic_model(), aci_model()

Examples

m <- aci_dyad_model()
aci_simulate(m, seed = 1, t_end = 2, dt = 0.01)
